scope: Control-only UI with explicit Connect and editable BL13 default
Automatic full-plot CSV archival on normal/error disconnection and close
design_review: Control mode display fixed; no startup/discovery/field editing starts a session; backend read-only test APIs preserved; unknown UI labels rejected.
BL13 editable/clearable, missing images remain unknown; original workbook/input validation and image handoff gates preserved.
Single background writer reuses seven-column atomic UTF8-BOM CSV; immutable full histories captured on Tk before reconnect/run reset; generation plus monotonic segment IDs.

Normal/error archive only after finished, preceding queued chart-only snapshots drained; close drain cannot restore proposals, state or actuation admission; deadline captures only confirmed records by cutoff.
Exclusive filenames, executable sibling records and LocalAppData fallback; failed batches retained across reconnect/reset; actual write failure on close keeps window/data or permits alternate folder.
